body_markdown:
Transformative technologies develop for years before they reach a decisive commercial inflection point. The car, the shipping container, and the internet each spent two decades or more in quiet incubation before they suddenly seemed inevitable. At our 2026 Analyst & Investor Day in Dallas, we made the case that autonomous trucking, and Aurora, have arrived at that moment.


We're no longer building toward a driverless product. We're operating one,[hauling freight for customers](https://aurora.tech/freight) on public roads every day. Since commercial launch, we've driven more than 500,000 driverless miles and set a vision for more than 30,000 Aurora Driver-powered trucks on the road in 2030.


Rather than recap the whole day here, I'd encourage you to watch it. You'll hear from Ossa Fisher on our accelerating commercial flywheel, Sandor Barna on our multi-platform path to scale, and David Maday on our path to scaled economics. You'll also hear directly from the customers and partners making this real, including Detmar Logistics, McLane, Werner, AUMOVIO, PACCAR, Roush, Volvo Autonomous Solutions, and Apollo Insurance.


## 2026 Analyst & Investor Day Keynote


Thank you to the customers, partners, and investors who joined us in Dallas and online.


Chris


[View the presentation and investor materials](https://ir.aurora.tech/)
